events.payout_structure: One in eight (1-in-8) entries will be in the money (approximately 12.5%). 12.5%-10% = $500 payout 10%-7.5% = $600 payout This Tournament must play until a winner is declared. Any adjustment to the posted prize pool requires approval of the tournament staff. Based on the remaining prize pool, tournament staff may dictate a minimum amount withheld which will be designated to the first-place winner, in such a manner that, regardless of the agreed upon adjustments made to the prize pool, the first-place winner will be awarded the largest cash prize. Mystery Bounty Rules: The Tournament will reward participants for eliminating another player (the "Bounty"). Each player who eliminates a Bounty from the Tournament will receive a prize (as outlined below) from the Bounty prize pool. Each player who advances to Day 3 will be designated as a "Mystery" Bounty. All Tournament and Bounty prizes are included in the Tournament guaranteed prize pool of $3,000,000 (the "Guarantee"). In the event that the number of paid entries does not generate at least the Guaranteed prize pool, after the deduction of the Tournament fees and service charge, $1,800,000 of the Guarantee will be designated for the Tournament prize pool and $1,200,000 of the Guarantee will be designated for the Bounty prize pool. In the event that multiple players eliminate a Bounty with the same winning hand, all players with a Tournament chip count equal to or greater than the eliminated Bounty prior to the start of the hand will equally split the corresponding Bounty prize. On Day 3, a player eliminating a Bounty will receive a voucher for a "Mystery" Bounty prize. "Mystery" Bounty prizes may be redeemed by presenting the Mystery Bounty prize voucher to the Tournament staff located at the designated redemption location, at which time the player will randomly draw an envelope from the "Mystery Bounty" drawing drum to reveal their "Mystery" Bounty prize. Once received, Mystery Bounty prize vouchers are the sole responsibility of the player. Lost or stolen Mystery Bounty prize vouchers will not be replaced. "Mystery" Bounty prize amounts will be based on $1,200,000 and displayed in the Tournament area prior to the beginning of the Tournament restart on Day 3. "Mystery" Bounty prizes will range in value from $1,000 to $100,000 and may include the following prizes: Sample Prize Values for the "Mystery Bounty" Prizes $100,000 $50,000 $25,000 $10,000 Gold Briefcase $5,000 $2,500 $1,000 The Mystery Bounty Prize Values and number of prizes are based on a minimum total Tournament Prize pool of $3,000,000 and is subject to change based upon the actual number of participants. The "Mystery" Bounty prize pool and prize amounts may not be altered. Gold Briefcase: Forty (40) of the mystery bounty envelopes will contain a gold briefcase. Winners of a gold briefcase will draw from a secondary drawing drum. The envelope that the player draws from the secondary drawing drum will award them the Gold Briefcase of the corresponding number. When the gold case is opened, the player will receive the prize revealed. All players who earn a Gold Briefcase will be required to draw their case at the conclusion of the dinner break. No player will be allowed to select their briefcase prior to this time. Players will draw their Gold Briefcase in the order in which they were won. When play resumes after the dinner break, any earned Gold Briefcases must be redeemed immediately. All Tournament and "Mystery" Bounty prizes will be paid in Wynn Las Vegas live casino chips. "Mystery" Bounty prizes may be redeemed at the designated redemption area anytime during play on December 13 or 14, 2026, up until the Tournament has concluded. All eliminated players must redeem any earned "Mystery" bounty prizes prior to collecting their tournament payout. "Mystery" Bounty prizes that have not been claimed by "Mystery" Bounty winners within the allotted timeframe will be drawn for in alphabetical order by last name, by Tournament staff, and held on account at the Encore at Wynn Las Vegas casino cage for thirty (30) days following the conclusion of the Tournament. If a "Mystery" Bounty prize is not claimed after thirty (30) days, the unclaimed "Mystery" Bounty prize will be forfeited and not awarded to an alternate winner. In the event that the number of envelopes at the conclusion of the Tournament is incorrect, every effort will be made to determine which prize(s) is outstanding based on the prize list published at the beginning of play on December 13, 2026.

"Mystery Payout" prizes that have not been claimed by "Mystery Payout" winners within the allotted timeframe will be drawn for by Tournament staff and held on account at the Encore at Wynn Las Vegas casino cage for thirty (30) days following the conclusion of the Tournament.
